fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-04-15, the complainant found that a signature resembling theirs had been used on a document connected to Rs. 50,000, though no such signing had taken place. The time of the incident was given as 09:05 on 2026-03-27. Kavitha Sri (9000000129), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. A person named Hemanth Arumugam, associated with the number 9000000264, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Signature allegedly imitated on a cheque or agreement.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged signature, morning, suspect, documents, mobile number, digital document, associate
